Record_ID: ▌  HEADLINE INDICATORS – Goals A, B, C, D and Targets 1–23

Indicator_Name: A.1 Red List of Ecosystems
Units_Measure: Red List Index of Ecosystems (RLIe), 0–1 scale
Policy_Goal: GBF Goal A – ecosystem integrity (primary); also informs T1, T2, T3. Relevant to SDG 15.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025); and CBD/SBSTTA/26/INF/14 (April 2024). Guidance on indicators of the KM-GBF monitoring framework. SBSTTA-26, Nairobi. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: National RLE assessments; IUCN Global Ecosystem Typology v2.1; national land-cover/ecosystem maps
Climate_Rationale: Red List of Ecosystems: expert classification; climate is a threat criterion but no climate data enter the index (Legend 1, rule B).

Indicator_Name: A.2 Extent of natural ecosystems
Units_Measure: Area (km²) of natural/semi-natural ecosystems by IUCN GET type; % change vs baseline
Policy_Goal: GBF Goal A – ecosystem integrity; also informs T1, T2, T3. Relevant to SDG 15.1 and SDG 6.6.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025); and CBD/SBSTTA/26/INF/14 (April 2024). Guidance on indicators of the KM-GBF monitoring framework. SBSTTA-26, Nairobi. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: National ecosystem maps (IUCN GET v2.1); ESA CCI / MODIS / Landsat; FAO FRA
Climate_Rationale: Extent from mapping or remote-sensing classification. Climate is a recognised long-run driver of change, but no climate data enter the area calculation and weather does not materially move the annual value (Legend 1, rule B).

Indicator_Name: A.3 Red List Index
Units_Measure: RLI, 0–1 scale; disaggregated by taxon and threat driver. Official SDG 15.5.1 (Tier 1).
Policy_Goal: GBF Goal A; also informs T4. Official SDG 15.5.1. Covers SDG 2.4, 2.5, 12.2, 13.1, 14.1–14.4, 15.1–15.8.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025); and CBD/SBSTTA/26/INF/14 (April 2024). Guidance on indicators of the KM-GBF monitoring framework. SBSTTA-26, Nairobi. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: IUCN Red List (https://www.iucnredlist.org); BirdLife International; SDG global database
Climate_Rationale: Aggregates IUCN Red List category changes. Climate change is a recognised threat driver, but assessments are expert status classifications: no climate data enter the calculation and weather does not move the annual value (Legend 1, rule B).

Indicator_Name: A.4 Proportion of populations within species with an effective population size > 500
Units_Measure: % of wildlife populations with Ne > 500; % of species with ≥1 population meeting criterion
Policy_Goal: GBF Goal A – genetic diversity; also informs T4. Relevant to SDG 2.5.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025); and CBD/SBSTTA/26/INF/14 (April 2024). Guidance on indicators of the KM-GBF monitoring framework. SBSTTA-26, Nairobi. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: IUCN Red List population data; genomic databases; Ne tools (NeEstimator, ONeSAMP); national monitoring
Climate_Rationale: Climate can reduce Ne via habitat fragmentation; data from surveys/genomics, not climate variables.

Indicator_Name: B.1 Services provided by ecosystems
Units_Measure: Physical supply/use flow accounts for ecosystem services (SEEA EA); monetary valuation optional
Policy_Goal: GBF Goal B – NCPs (primary); also informs T11. Relevant to SDG 6, 14 and 15.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025); and CBD/SBSTTA/26/INF/14 (April 2024). Guidance on indicators of the KM-GBF monitoring framework. SBSTTA-26, Nairobi. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: National SEEA EA accounts; hydrological models; carbon inventories; IPBES NCP assessments; UNSD
Climate_Rationale: Ecosystem service flows (carbon, water regulation, coastal protection) directly affected by climate change.

Indicator_Name: C.1 Monetary benefits received under applicable ABS instruments
Units_Measure: USD million/year monetary benefits shared under ABS instruments (Nagoya Protocol etc.)
Policy_Goal: GBF Goal C – equitable benefit-sharing; also informs T13. Relevant to SDG 15.6.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025); and CBD/SBSTTA/26/INF/14 (April 2024). Guidance on indicators of the KM-GBF monitoring framework. SBSTTA-26, Nairobi. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: CBD ABS Clearing-House (https://absch.cbd.int); OECD CRS; national reports to CBD
Climate_Rationale: Monetary ABS transactions from financial records; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: C.2 Non-monetary benefits arising from applicable ABS instruments
Units_Measure: Count and typology of non-monetary benefits (technology transfer, capacity-building, joint research)
Policy_Goal: GBF Goal C – equitable benefit-sharing; also informs T13. Relevant to SDG 15.6.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025); and CBD/SBSTTA/26/INF/14 (April 2024). Guidance on indicators of the KM-GBF monitoring framework. SBSTTA-26, Nairobi. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: ABS Clearing-House; CBD national reports; Nagoya Protocol implementation reports; FAO ITPGRFA
Climate_Rationale: Non-monetary ABS from agreements; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: D.1 International public finance for biodiversity (including ODA)
Units_Measure: USD billion/year; international public finance for biodiversity (ODA/OOF Rio Markers; TOSSD)
Policy_Goal: GBF Goal D – means of implementation; also informs T19. Relevant to SDG 15.a and SDG 17.18.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025); and CBD/SBSTTA/26/INF/14 (April 2024). Guidance on indicators of the KM-GBF monitoring framework. SBSTTA-26, Nairobi. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: OECD DAC CRS – Rio Markers; TOSSD database; CBD Finance Portal
Climate_Rationale: Financial flows from OECD reporting; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: D.2 Domestic public finance for biodiversity
Policy_Sector: Nature & Biodiversity | Finance | Governance, Society & Data
Units_Measure: USD billion/year; domestic government expenditure on biodiversity and ecosystem conservation
Policy_Goal: GBF Goal D – means of implementation; also informs T19. Relevant to SDG 15.a.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025); and CBD/SBSTTA/26/INF/14 (April 2024). Guidance on indicators of the KM-GBF monitoring framework. SBSTTA-26, Nairobi. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: National government budget records; CBD Finance Portal; OECD environment expenditure statistics
Climate_Rationale: Domestic expenditure from national budget records; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: D.3 Private finance for biodiversity (domestic and international)
Units_Measure: USD billion/year; private financial flows for biodiversity conservation and sustainable use
Policy_Goal: GBF Goal D – means of implementation; also informs T19. Relevant to SDG 17.14.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025); and CBD/SBSTTA/26/INF/14 (April 2024). Guidance on indicators of the KM-GBF monitoring framework. SBSTTA-26, Nairobi. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: OECD CRS private finance; CBD Finance Portal; Bloomberg / MSCI ESG; green bond databases
Climate_Rationale: Private finance from investment databases; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: 1.1 Percentage of land and sea area covered by biodiversity-inclusive spatial plans
Units_Measure: % of national terrestrial, inland water and marine area under biodiversity-inclusive spatial plans
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 1 – spatial planning (headline). Relevant to SDG 15.9. Metadata under further development (COP-16).
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025); and CBD/SBSTTA/26/INF/14 (April 2024). Guidance on indicators of the KM-GBF monitoring framework. SBSTTA-26, Nairobi. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: National spatial planning databases; biodiversity-inclusive plan registers; CBD national reporting portal
Climate_Rationale: Spatial plan coverage from governance records; climate considerations increasingly embedded in planning but coverage metric is not climate-derived.

Indicator_Name: 2.1 Area under restoration
Units_Measure: Hectares of degraded terrestrial, freshwater and marine ecosystems under active or completed restoration, by ecosystem type
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 2 – restore 30% of degraded ecosystems (headline). Relevant to SDG 15.3.1.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025); and CBD/SBSTTA/26/INF/14 (April 2024). Guidance on indicators of the KM-GBF monitoring framework. SBSTTA-26, Nairobi. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: National restoration programme records; NBSAPs; FAO FRA; UNCCD national reports; IUCN Restoration Barometer
Climate_Rationale: Area under restoration from programme records; no climate or weather data enter the calculation and weather does not move the value. Climate relevance of the subject is carried by Policy_Sector, not by this score (rule A). Aligned with [IND-B-133].

Indicator_Name: 3.1 Coverage of protected areas and other effective area-based conservation measures
Units_Measure: % of terrestrial, inland water and marine areas under PA/OECM; disaggregated by ecosystem type, KBA and effectiveness. Official SDG 14.5.1 and SDG 15.1.2 (Tier 1).
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 3 – 30×30 (headline). Official SDG 14.5.1 and SDG 15.1.2. Relevant to SDG 15.4.1.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025); and CBD/SBSTTA/26/INF/14 (April 2024). Guidance on indicators of the KM-GBF monitoring framework. SBSTTA-26, Nairobi. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: WDPA (UNEP-WCMC / IUCN); WD-OECM; Protected Planet (https://www.protectedplanet.net); KBA database
Climate_Rationale: Coverage from WDPA/WD-OECM designation databases; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: 5.1 Proportion of fish stocks within biologically sustainable levels
Units_Measure: % of assessed marine fish stocks at biologically sustainable levels; official SDG 14.4.1 (Tier 1).
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 5 – sustainable use of wild species (headline). Official SDG 14.4.1. Relevant to SDG 14.2.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025); and CBD/SBSTTA/26/INF/14 (April 2024). Guidance on indicators of the KM-GBF monitoring framework. SBSTTA-26, Nairobi. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: FAO Fisheries Division; national fisheries authorities; RFMO stock assessments (ICES, CCAMLR, WCPFC)
Climate_Rationale: SST embedded in stock productivity and recruitment models; ocean warming alters sustainable yield reference points.

Indicator_Name: 6.1 Rate of invasive alien species establishment
Units_Measure: Rate of new IAS establishment events per year; cumulative established IAS count
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 6 – eliminate and control IAS (headline). Relevant to SDG 15.8.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025); and CBD/SBSTTA/26/INF/14 (April 2024). Guidance on indicators of the KM-GBF monitoring framework. SBSTTA-26, Nairobi. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: GRIIS (IUCN); GBIF; national IAS inventories; Seebens et al. alien species database
Climate_Rationale: IAS primarily driven by trade/travel; climate warming facilitates establishment and expansion.

Indicator_Name: 7.1 Index of coastal eutrophication (ICEP)
Units_Measure: ICEP: kg C/km²/day from riverine nutrient inputs to coast; subset of SDG 14.1.1
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 7 – reduce nutrient pollution (headline). Subset SDG 14.1.1. Relevant to SDG 14.1 and SDG 6.3.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025); and CBD/SBSTTA/26/INF/14 (April 2024). Guidance on indicators of the KM-GBF monitoring framework. SBSTTA-26, Nairobi. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: Global NEWS model; FAO fertiliser statistics; GEMS/Water; IOC-UNESCO / UN Environment
Climate_Rationale: Global NEWS uses precipitation-derived runoff as direct input; rainfall patterns control riverine nutrient transport.

Indicator_Name: 7.2 Pesticide environment concentration and/or aggregated total applied toxicity (ATAT)
Units_Measure: ATAT: hazard-weighted pesticide application intensity; and/or pesticide environment concentration (Parties choose)
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 7 – reduce pesticide pollution (headline; Parties choose reporting approach). Relevant to SDG 2.4.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025); and CBD/SBSTTA/26/INF/14 (April 2024). Guidance on indicators of the KM-GBF monitoring framework. SBSTTA-26, Nairobi. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: FAO FAOSTAT; national pesticide databases; ECOTOX/PPDB ecotoxicology databases. Custodian: FAO.
Climate_Rationale: Pesticide application from agricultural statistics; no climate data; further metadata development in progress.

Indicator_Name: 9.1 Benefits from the sustainable use of wild species
Policy_Sector: Nature & Biodiversity | Land Use & Agriculture | Health
Units_Measure: Composite sub-indicators on value of wild-sourced food, medicine, timber, recreation and cultural use; preliminary methodology
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 9 – sustainable use benefits (headline). Metadata under further development (COP-16). Relevant to SDG 2.4.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025); and CBD/SBSTTA/26/INF/14 (April 2024). Guidance on indicators of the KM-GBF monitoring framework. SBSTTA-26, Nairobi. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: FAO FishStat; FAOSTAT; CITES Trade Database; IPBES sustainability assessments
Climate_Rationale: Harvest volumes tracked from economic statistics; climate affects wild species availability but statistics not directly climate-adjusted.

Indicator_Name: 9.2 Percentage of the population in traditional occupations reliant on wild species
Units_Measure: % of national population in traditional occupations reliant on wild species; by gender and IPLC status
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 9 – traditional occupations (headline). Relevant to SDG 8.3 and SDG 1.1.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025); and CBD/SBSTTA/26/INF/14 (April 2024). Guidance on indicators of the KM-GBF monitoring framework. SBSTTA-26, Nairobi. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: National census/labour force surveys; FAO fishing/forestry employment; ILO employment databases
Climate_Rationale: Traditional occupations disrupted by climate via altered fish stocks and seasonal patterns; measured from census data.

Indicator_Name: 10.1 Proportion of agricultural area under productive and sustainable agriculture
Units_Measure: % of agricultural area meeting environmental sustainability criteria; by farming system
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 10 – sustainable agriculture and forestry (headline). Relevant to SDG 2.4.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025); and CBD/SBSTTA/26/INF/14 (April 2024). Guidance on indicators of the KM-GBF monitoring framework. SBSTTA-26, Nairobi. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: FAO FAOSTAT; national agricultural censuses; agri-environment scheme data; organic/SAN certification databases
Climate_Rationale: Sustainable agriculture area from certification records; climate creates demand for agri-environment schemes but area metric not climate-derived.

Indicator_Name: 10.2 Progress towards sustainable forest management
Units_Measure: Composite of 5 sub-indicators: forest area, growing stock, area under management plans, certified timber, forest carbon stocks
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 10 – sustainable forestry (headline). Relevant to SDG 15.2 and SDG 13.1 (forests as carbon sinks).
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025); and CBD/SBSTTA/26/INF/14 (April 2024). Guidance on indicators of the KM-GBF monitoring framework. SBSTTA-26, Nairobi. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: FAO Global Forest Resources Assessment (FRA); FSC / PEFC certification databases; EU FLEGT
Climate_Rationale: Forest area/growing stock partly affected by climate-driven fire and drought; sub-indicator 5 (forest carbon) has direct climate relevance.

Indicator_Name: 12.1 Average share of built-up area of cities that is green or blue space for public use for all
Units_Measure: % of urban built-up area that is accessible public green or blue space; by city size class
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 12 – urban green and blue spaces (headline). Relevant to SDG 11.7.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025); and CBD/SBSTTA/26/INF/14 (April 2024). Guidance on indicators of the KM-GBF monitoring framework. SBSTTA-26, Nairobi. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: City land-use plans; high-resolution satellite imagery (Sentinel-2); UN-Habitat urban data
Climate_Rationale: Green and blue space share from land-use mapping; no climate or weather data enter the calculation and weather does not move the value. Climate relevance of the subject is carried by Policy_Sector, not by this score (rule A). Aligned with [IND-J-065].

Indicator_Name: 15.1 Number of companies disclosing biodiversity-related risks, dependencies and impacts
Units_Measure: Count of companies that have assessed and disclosed biodiversity risks/dependencies/impacts; by sector
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 15 – business assessment and disclosure (headline). Relevant to SDG 12.6 and SDG 17.14.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025); and CBD/SBSTTA/26/INF/14 (April 2024). Guidance on indicators of the KM-GBF monitoring framework. SBSTTA-26, Nairobi. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: TNFD Disclosure database (https://tnfd.global); GRI Sustainability Disclosure Database; EU CSRD; CDP Nature
Climate_Rationale: Disclosure counts from reporting databases; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: 18.1 Positive incentives in place to promote biodiversity conservation and sustainable use
Units_Measure: Number of positive incentives by type and sector; monetary value where available (USD billion/year)
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 18 – eliminate harmful subsidies, scale up positive incentives (headline). Relevant to SDG 15.9 and SDG 15.a.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025); and CBD/SBSTTA/26/INF/14 (April 2024). Guidance on indicators of the KM-GBF monitoring framework. SBSTTA-26, Nairobi. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: OECD PINE database; CBD CHM national incentive databases; national budgets and tax policy records
Climate_Rationale: Positive incentive counts from administrative policy records; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: 18.2 Value of subsidies and other incentives harmful to biodiversity
Policy_Sector: Nature & Biodiversity | Marine & Fisheries | Land Use & Agriculture
Units_Measure: USD billion/year of potentially harmful subsidies by sector (agriculture, fisheries, fossil fuels, infrastructure)
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 18 – eliminate harmful subsidies (headline). Relevant to SDG 15.9, SDG 2.4 and SDG 14.6.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025); and CBD/SBSTTA/26/INF/14 (April 2024). Guidance on indicators of the KM-GBF monitoring framework. SBSTTA-26, Nairobi. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: OECD PSE database; Global Fossil Fuel Subsidies database (IEA/OECD/IMF); Sumaila et al. fishing subsidy database
Climate_Rationale: Subsidy values from financial accounts and OECD statistics; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: 21.1 Indicator on biodiversity information for monitoring the KM-GBF
Units_Measure: Composite index of data availability, quality and coverage for biodiversity monitoring
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 21 – knowledge and data for decision-making (headline). Relevant to SDG 17.18.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025); and CBD/SBSTTA/26/INF/14 (April 2024). Guidance on indicators of the KM-GBF monitoring framework. SBSTTA-26, Nairobi. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: GBIF (https://www.gbif.org); GEO BON EBVs; national biodiversity monitoring capacity assessments; CBD CHM
Climate_Rationale: Biodiversity data availability index from database statistics; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: 22 Land-use change and land tenure in traditional territories of indigenous peoples and local communities
Policy_Sector: Land Use & Agriculture | Governance, Society & Data
Units_Measure: Area and rate of land-use change; proportion of traditional territories with secure tenure; methodology under development (COP-16)
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 22 – IPLC rights (headline; under development). Relevant to SDG 15.1 and SDG 16.7.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025); and CBD/SBSTTA/26/INF/14 (April 2024). Guidance on indicators of the KM-GBF monitoring framework. SBSTTA-26, Nairobi. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: National cadastral and land tenure data; remote sensing; IPLC territory registers; CBD national reporting
Climate_Rationale: Land-use change in IPLC territories partly driven by climate pressures (fire, drought); tenure data from administrative records.

Record_ID: ▌  BINARY INDICATORS – Governance progress scores (0–5 scale per CBD COP-16 Annex III questions)

Indicator_Name: B.b Number of countries with policies or actions for implementing and monitoring the sustainable use of biodiversity and the maintenance and enhancement of nature's contributions to people, including ecosystem functions and services
Units_Measure: Binary governance progress score (0–5) based on 4 questions on: NCP policies; sustainable use policies; monitoring of sustainable use; monitoring of NCPs
Policy_Goal: GBF Goal B / T9 (binary). Tracks governance of sustainable use and NCPs. Relevant to SDG 15.9.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025); and CBD/SBSTTA/26/INF/14 (April 2024). Guidance on indicators of the KM-GBF monitoring framework. SBSTTA-26, Nairobi. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: CBD national reporting portal; NBSAPs; national NCP monitoring reports
Climate_Rationale: Binary governance indicator; answered from policy documents; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: 1.b Number of countries using participatory, integrated and biodiversity-inclusive spatial planning and/or effective management processes addressing land- and sea-use change to bring loss of areas of high biodiversity importance close to zero by 2030
Units_Measure: Binary governance progress score (0–5) based on questions on: biodiversity-inclusive spatial plans for terrestrial/inland water/marine; participatory process
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 1 – spatial planning (binary). Relevant to SDG 15.9.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025); and CBD/SBSTTA/26/INF/14 (April 2024). Guidance on indicators of the KM-GBF monitoring framework. SBSTTA-26, Nairobi. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: CBD national reporting portal; national spatial plans; EIA/SEA legislation databases
Climate_Rationale: Binary governance indicator; answered from policy documents; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: 5.b Number of countries with legal instruments or other policy frameworks for regulating trade in wild species
Units_Measure: Binary governance progress score (0–5) based on 1 question with 5 sub-options: legal instruments for terrestrial, freshwater, marine and international trade in wild species
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 5 – sustainable trade governance (binary). Relevant to SDG 15.7 and SDG 15.5.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025); and CBD/SBSTTA/26/INF/14 (April 2024). Guidance on indicators of the KM-GBF monitoring framework. SBSTTA-26, Nairobi. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: CBD national reporting portal; national wildlife trade legislation; CITES national reports
Climate_Rationale: Binary governance indicator; answered from legislative records; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: 6.b Number of countries adopting relevant regulations, processes and measures to reduce the impact of invasive alien species
Policy_Sector: Nature & Biodiversity | Biosecurity | Governance, Society & Data

Climate_Rationale: Forest area from national inventories; climate drives long-term extent through fire and drought but not directly calculated.

Indicator_Name: A.CY.2 Rate of tree cover loss
Units_Measure: % per year or ha/year loss of tree canopy cover from satellite data; disaggregated by driver
Policy_Goal: GBF Goal A (complementary). Dynamic deforestation rate at high resolution.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: Hansen et al. / UMD Global Forest Change (Landsat); Global Forest Watch (GFW)
Climate_Rationale: Tree cover loss includes climate-driven fire; Landsat maps capture fire-driven losses; warming extends fire seasons.

Indicator_Name: A.CY.3 Mountain Green Cover Index
Units_Measure: Index of mountain ecosystem green cover (vegetation % of mountain area); official SDG 15.4.2
Policy_Goal: GBF Goal A (complementary). Mountain ecosystem vegetation status. Official SDG 15.4.2.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: MODIS land cover; FAO; UNEP-WCMC mountain ecosystem layers
Climate_Rationale: Mountain NDVI directly affected by temperature (growing season length) and precipitation.

Indicator_Name: A.CY.4 Continuous global mangrove forest cover (CGMFC-21)
Units_Measure: Annual global mangrove forest cover (ha) from JAXA Global Mangrove Watch (21st century time series)
Policy_Goal: GBF Goal A (complementary). Continuous monitoring of mangrove extent.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: JAXA Global Mangrove Watch (ALOS/Landsat); Hamilton & Casey 2016
Climate_Rationale: Extent from mapping or remote-sensing classification. Climate is a recognised long-run driver of change, but no climate data enter the area calculation and weather does not materially move the annual value (Legend 1, rule B).

Indicator_Name: A.CY.5 Mangrove forest fragmentation
Units_Measure: Fragmentation index for mangrove forest patches (proportion in small isolated patches)
Policy_Goal: GBF Goal A (complementary). Structural integrity of remaining mangrove forest.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: JAXA Global Mangrove Watch; spatial fragmentation analysis (FRAGSTATS); UNEP-WCMC
Climate_Rationale: Mangrove fragmentation from mapped extent. Extent from mapping or remote-sensing classification. Climate is a recognised long-run driver of change, but no climate data enter the area calculation and weather does not materially move the annual value (Legend 1, rule B).

Indicator_Name: A.CY.6 Mangrove extent
Units_Measure: Total area (ha) of mangrove ecosystems globally and by country; trend over time
Policy_Goal: GBF Goal A (complementary). Stand-alone global mangrove area (complements A.CY.4 and A.CY.5).
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: Global Mangrove Watch; Ramsar; UNEP-WCMC mangrove datasets; national mangrove inventories
Climate_Rationale: Extent from mapping or remote-sensing classification. Climate is a recognised long-run driver of change, but no climate data enter the area calculation and weather does not materially move the annual value (Legend 1, rule B).

Indicator_Name: A.CY.7 Global salt marsh extent
Units_Measure: Total area (ha) of coastal salt marsh globally; trend over time
Policy_Goal: GBF Goal A (complementary). Salt marshes as blue carbon habitats under climate threat.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: Mcowen et al. 2017 dataset; Blue Carbon Initiative; national coastal habitat surveys; Sentinel-2
Climate_Rationale: Extent from mapping or remote-sensing classification. Climate is a recognised long-run driver of change, but no climate data enter the area calculation and weather does not materially move the annual value (Legend 1, rule B).

Indicator_Name: A.CY.8 Wetland Extent Trends (WET) Index
Units_Measure: Index (baseline = 100); % change in natural wetland area; by wetland type
Policy_Goal: GBF Goal A (complementary). Tracks natural wetland extent globally. Relevant to Ramsar and SDG 6.6.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: WETLANDS International GWDE; Ramsar; MODIS surface water; national wetland inventories
Climate_Rationale: Wetland extent strongly affected by rainfall patterns and drought; precipitation is a direct driver.

Indicator_Name: A.CY.9 Forest Fragmentation Index
Units_Measure: Index of spatial fragmentation of remaining forest cover (edge/patch/core classification)
Policy_Goal: GBF Goal A (complementary). Forest habitat fragmentation as a biodiversity threat beyond area loss.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: ESA CCI Land Cover; Hansen et al. forest cover; FRAGSTATS landscape metrics
Climate_Rationale: Forest fragmentation from mapped forest cover; climate-driven fire is a background driver but no climate data enter (Legend 1, rule B).

Indicator_Name: A.CY.10 Forest Landscape Integrity Index (FLII)
Units_Measure: Index (1 = fully intact; 0 = fully modified) of anthropogenic modification within forest landscapes
Policy_Goal: GBF Goal A (complementary). Forest landscape integrity including edge effects and degradation.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: Grantham et al. 2020 global FLII dataset; Hansen forest cover; GFW road network
Climate_Rationale: FLII based on land-use modification; climate-driven fire increasingly affects values.

Indicator_Name: A.CY.11 Global Vegetation Health Products (VHP)
Units_Measure: Vegetation Health Index (VHI) from NOAA AVHRR; anomalies in vegetation condition and stress
Policy_Goal: GBF Goal A (complementary). Real-time vegetation stress and health using satellite data.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: NOAA AVHRR/VIIRS VHI products; NOAA Centre for Satellite Applications
Climate_Rationale: VHI directly reflects drought, heat stress and climate-driven vegetation anomalies; temperature and moisture are primary inputs.

Indicator_Name: A.CY.12 Relative magnitude of fragmentation
Units_Measure: Comparative fragmentation metric across ecosystem types relative to historical baseline
Policy_Goal: GBF Goal A (complementary). Contextualises current fragmentation trends against historical reference.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: Remote sensing land-cover time series; landscape ecology analysis tools; Map of Life
Climate_Rationale: Fragmentation trends from remote sensing; climate-driven fires and droughts contribute.

Indicator_Name: A.CY.13 Ocean Health Index
Units_Measure: Composite score (0–100) across 10 ocean health goals (food, clean water, biodiversity, etc.)
Policy_Goal: GBF Goal A / Goal B (complementary). Overall health of marine ecosystems and services to people.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: NCEAS; Halpern et al. 2012, 2015, 2022 (Nature); multiple global marine datasets
Climate_Rationale: Ocean warming and acidification are components of OHI; SST embedded in several goal scores.

Indicator_Name: A.CY.14 Extent of physical damage to predominant seafloor habitats
Units_Measure: Area (km²) of seafloor habitat physically damaged by bottom trawling, mining and other disturbances
Policy_Goal: GBF Goal A (complementary). Seabed integrity as a dimension of marine biodiversity.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: ICES VMS fishing effort data; Global Fishing Watch; OSPAR benthic habitat monitoring
Climate_Rationale: Physical damage from fishing/mining tracked from vessel monitoring data; no climate inputs.

Indicator_Name: A.CY.15 River Fragmentation Index
Units_Measure: Index of how fragmented river networks are by dams and other structures
Policy_Goal: GBF Goal A (complementary). Freshwater connectivity for migratory and freshwater species.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: Grill et al. 2019 (Nature); Global Dam Watch; HydroSHEDS
Climate_Rationale: River fragmentation from GIS infrastructure data; climate change affects flow regimes but not the connectivity index directly.

Indicator_Name: A.CY.16 Mean species abundance
Units_Measure: Index of mean local abundance of species relative to undisturbed reference state
Policy_Goal: GBF Goal A (complementary). Whether local biodiversity abundance is maintained at landscape scale.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: GLOBIO model; PREDICTS; land-use maps; national biodiversity monitoring
Climate_Rationale: MSA modelled from land-use; climate as background variable affecting habitat suitability.

Indicator_Name: A.CY.17 Changes in plankton biomass and abundance
Units_Measure: Index of phytoplankton and zooplankton biomass and community composition change
Policy_Goal: GBF Goal A (complementary). Plankton as foundational marine biodiversity and food web indicator.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: CPR Survey (SAHFOS / CEFAS); MODIS ocean colour; ARGO floats; IOC-UNESCO OBIS
Climate_Rationale: Plankton biomass and community indices from CPR, ocean colour and survey data; SST and stratification move values strongly but are not an input to the index (Legend 2, rule D; aligned with [IND-E-019]).

Indicator_Name: A.CY.18 Comprehensiveness of conservation of socioeconomically and culturally valuable species
Units_Measure: Index of gap coverage for valuable species in ex-situ and in-situ conservation collections
Policy_Goal: GBF Goal A (complementary). Conservation gaps for species important to human well-being.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: GENEBANK platform; national genebanks; GBIF; crop wild relative datasets; Khoury et al.
Climate_Rationale: Gap analysis from occurrence and collection data; no climate inputs.

Indicator_Name: A.CY.19 Red List Index – wild relatives of domesticated animals
Units_Measure: RLI (0–1) for wild relatives of domesticated animal species used in food and agriculture
Policy_Goal: GBF Goal A / T4, T10 (complementary). Genetic resource for food security under climate change.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: IUCN Red List; FAO list of wild relatives of domesticated animals; IUCN SSC specialist groups
Climate_Rationale: Aggregates IUCN Red List category changes. Climate change is a recognised threat driver, but assessments are expert status classifications: no climate data enter the calculation and weather does not move the annual value (Legend 1, rule B).

Indicator_Name: A.CY.20 Species Status Information Index
Units_Measure: Index of data availability and completeness for species status assessments
Policy_Goal: GBF Goal A / T21 (complementary). Whether sufficient data exist to assess species status.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: IUCN Red List database coverage statistics; GBIF backbone taxonomy; GEO BON
Climate_Rationale: Data coverage metrics from IUCN assessment records; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: A.CY.21 Expected loss of phylogenetic diversity
Units_Measure: Expected fraction of total evolutionary history (million branch-years) lost under current extinction trajectories
Policy_Goal: GBF Goal A (complementary). Loss of evolutionary heritage beyond species count.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: IUCN Red List; timetree.org; Redding & Mooers (2006) methodology; Jetz et al. phylogenetic databases
Climate_Rationale: Expected loss of phylogenetic diversity is computed from Red List extinction probabilities; no climate data enter (Legend 1, rule B).

Indicator_Name: A.CY.22 Proportion of populations maintained within species
Units_Measure: % of wild populations within species that are maintained (extant vs historically known populations)
Policy_Goal: GBF Goal A / T4 (complementary). Population-level tracking as finer resolution than Ne > 500 (A.4).
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: National population monitoring; IUCN Red List population data; species demographic surveys
Climate_Rationale: Population maintenance affected by climate through habitat changes; data from population surveys.

Indicator_Name: B.CY.1 Red List Index – pollinating species
Units_Measure: RLI (0–1) for wild pollinator species (bees, hoverflies, moths, butterflies)
Policy_Goal: GBF Goal B / T4, T11 (complementary). Pollinators underpin food production and ecosystem function.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: IUCN Red List; IPBES Pollination Assessment 2016; pollinators specialist groups
Climate_Rationale: Aggregates IUCN Red List category changes. Climate change is a recognised threat driver, but assessments are expert status classifications: no climate data enter the calculation and weather does not move the annual value (Legend 1, rule B).

Indicator_Name: B.CY.2 Forestry production and trade (wood fuel)
Units_Measure: Volume (m³/year) and value (USD/year) of wood fuel production and trade
Policy_Goal: GBF Goal B / T10 (complementary). Provisioning ecosystem service from forests for energy.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: FAO FAOSTAT forestry production statistics; ITTO timber trade data
Climate_Rationale: Wood fuel production from FAO forestry statistics; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: B.CY.3 UNESCO culture|2030 indicators
Units_Measure: Suite of indicators on culture and sustainable development, including nature-based cultural practices
Policy_Goal: GBF Goal B / T22 (complementary). Cultural contributions of nature to sustainable development.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: UNESCO Institute for Statistics; national cultural heritage databases
Climate_Rationale: Cultural heritage indicators from UNESCO surveys; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: C.CY.1 Number of users providing information on utilisation of genetic resources to designated checkpoints
Units_Measure: Count of user reports submitted to national checkpoints under Nagoya Protocol
Policy_Goal: GBF Goal C / T13 (complementary). ABS compliance reporting through checkpoint system.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: CBD ABS Clearing-House checkpoint submissions; national ABS checkpoint databases
Climate_Rationale: ABS user reports from administrative records; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: C.CY.2 Number of checkpoint communiqués published on the ABS Clearing-House
Units_Measure: Count of communiqués from designated checkpoints published on ABS Clearing-House
Policy_Goal: GBF Goal C / T13 (complementary). ABS compliance verification communications.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: CBD ABS Clearing-House (https://absch.cbd.int)
Climate_Rationale: Communiqué counts from ABS Clearing-House records; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: C.CY.3 Total number of IRCCs for non-commercial purposes in the ABS Clearing-House
Units_Measure: Count of internationally recognised certificates of compliance for non-commercial genetic resource utilisation
Policy_Goal: GBF Goal C / T13 (complementary). ABS compliance for academic and research purposes.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: CBD ABS Clearing-House (https://absch.cbd.int); CBD Secretariat
Climate_Rationale: IRCC counts from ABS Clearing-House; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: D.CY.1 Number of researchers per million population
Units_Measure: Full-time equivalent researchers per million inhabitants; SDG 9.5.2
Policy_Goal: GBF Goal D (complementary). Research capacity as means of implementation. Relevant to SDG 9.5.2.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: UNESCO Institute for Statistics; national R&D surveys; OECD MSTI database
Climate_Rationale: Research capacity from educational/institutional records; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: D.CY.2 Number of joint scientific papers published in OBIS by sector
Units_Measure: Annual count of biodiversity-related publications using OBIS marine biodiversity data, by sector
Policy_Goal: GBF Goal D (complementary). Scientific cooperation as means of implementation.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: Ocean Biodiversity Information System (OBIS) publication metrics; Scopus/Web of Science
Climate_Rationale: Publication counts from bibliometric databases; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: D.CY.3 Proportion of total R&D budget allocated to marine technology research
Units_Measure: % of national R&D budget allocated to marine technology; SDG 14.a.1
Policy_Goal: GBF Goal D (complementary). Marine technology research investment. Relevant to SDG 14.a.1.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: UNESCO UIS; national R&D budget statistics; OECD MSTI
Climate_Rationale: R&D budget allocation from national statistical records; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: D.CY.4 Volume of ODA flows for scholarships by sector and type of study
Policy_Sector: Nature & Biodiversity | Finance | Governance, Society & Data
Units_Measure: USD million/year in ODA for scholarships and education in environment/biodiversity fields
Policy_Goal: GBF Goal D (complementary). Education and training finance as capacity-building means.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: OECD DAC CRS; UNESCO UIS scholarship tracking
Climate_Rationale: ODA scholarship data from OECD financial records; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: D.CY.5 Global imports of ICT goods by category
Units_Measure: USD million/year in global ICT goods imports; technology access proxy
Policy_Goal: GBF Goal D (complementary). ICT access as technology transfer indicator.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: UNCTAD bilateral trade statistics; WTO International Trade Statistics; national customs data
Climate_Rationale: ICT trade from customs/trade records; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: D.CY.6 International funding targeted at IPLCs within biodiversity-related activities
Policy_Sector: Nature & Biodiversity | Finance | Governance, Society & Data
Units_Measure: USD million/year in biodiversity-related international finance directed to indigenous and local communities
Policy_Goal: GBF Goal D / T19, T22 (complementary). Equity in biodiversity finance for IPLCs.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: OECD DAC CRS IPLC-disaggregated; CBD Finance Portal; indigenous finance tracking databases
Climate_Rationale: Finance flows from OECD CRS disaggregation; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: D.CY.7 International funding targeted at youth within biodiversity-related activities
Policy_Sector: Nature & Biodiversity | Finance | Governance, Society & Data
Units_Measure: USD million/year in biodiversity-related international finance directed to youth organisations
Policy_Goal: GBF Goal D / T19 (complementary). Equity in biodiversity finance for youth.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: OECD DAC CRS; CBD Finance Portal; youth programme financial tracking
Climate_Rationale: Finance flows from OECD CRS disaggregation; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: D.CY.8 International funding targeted at gender equality within biodiversity-related activities
Policy_Sector: Nature & Biodiversity | Finance | Governance, Society & Data
Units_Measure: USD million/year in biodiversity-related international finance with gender equality objectives
Policy_Goal: GBF Goal D / T19, T23 (complementary). Gender-responsive biodiversity finance.

Data_Source: Ecosystem Marketplace; voluntary corporate philanthropy reports

Data_Source: Ecosystem Marketplace; impact investing databases; UN Women private finance tracking

Indicator_Name: D.CY.17 Private funding mobilised for IPLCs, women and youth (combined)

Units_Measure: USD million/year in private biodiversity finance specifically mobilised for IPLCs, women and youth
