Data_Source: Impact investing databases; development finance institutions; voluntary private sector reports
Climate_Rationale: Private finance flows from databases and voluntary reports; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: 1.CY.1 Proportion of transboundary basin area with an operational arrangement for water cooperation
Units_Measure: % of transboundary basin area under operational water cooperation arrangements; SDG 6.5.2
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 1 (complementary). Transboundary water governance as a spatial planning enabler. Official SDG 6.5.2.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: UNECE / UNESCO SDG 6.5.2 monitoring programme; national transboundary water agreements
Climate_Rationale: Water cooperation agreements from treaty databases; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: 2.CY.1 Global Ecosystem Restoration Index
Units_Measure: Index tracking restoration activity and outcomes against UN Decade on Ecosystem Restoration targets
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 2 (complementary). Restoration outcomes beyond area alone (quality dimension).
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: UNEP UN Decade on Ecosystem Restoration platform; national restoration programme databases; IUCN
Climate_Rationale: Restoration index aggregates programme data; climate affects restoration success rates but index is primarily governance-based.

Indicator_Name: 2.CY.2 Proportion of Key Biodiversity Areas in favourable condition
Units_Measure: % of KBAs assessed as being in good/favourable ecological condition
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 2 / T3 (complementary). Ecological quality of globally important biodiversity sites.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: KBA database (BirdLife International / IUCN); national KBA condition assessments; WDPA
Climate_Rationale: KBA condition from ecological assessments; climate pressures affect condition for some KBAs.

Indicator_Name: 3.CY.1 Rate of protected area downgrading, downsizing and degazettement (PADDD)
Units_Measure: Number and area (ha/year) of PADDD events; disaggregated by country and reason
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 3 (complementary). Losses of formal protection undermining the 30×30 target.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: PADDD Tracker (WWF / Conservation Biology Institute); national legislation databases; WDPA historical data
Climate_Rationale: PADDD events from legal/administrative databases; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: 3.CY.2 IUCN Green List of Protected and Conserved Areas Standard
Units_Measure: Number and area (ha) of PAs meeting the IUCN Green List Standard for effective and equitable management
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 3 (complementary). High-quality PA management beyond just coverage.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: IUCN Green List Standard database; IUCN WCPA; national PA management evaluation
Climate_Rationale: Green List assessments from management records; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: 3.CY.3 Protected Area Isolation Index
Units_Measure: Index of isolation of protected areas from other natural habitats (inverse of connectivity)
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 3 (complementary). Vulnerability of PAs to edge effects and ecological isolation.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: WDPA; ESA CCI land cover; landscape connectivity analysis; human footprint datasets
Climate_Rationale: Isolation calculated from GIS land-cover data; no climate inputs.

Indicator_Name: 3.CY.4 Protected Areas Network metric
Units_Measure: Composite metric assessing coverage, connectivity and effectiveness of the PA network
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 3 (complementary). Holistic network-level PA system assessment.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: WDPA; GD-PAME; Protected Planet; PARC suite of indicators
Climate_Rationale: PA network metrics from designation and assessment databases; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: 3.CY.5 Number of protected areas with completed site-level governance and equity assessment
Units_Measure: Count/% of PAs with a completed site-level governance and equity assessment (e.g. SAPA framework)
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 3 (complementary). Quality of PA governance including equity dimensions.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: IUCN WCPA; IUCN governance and equity databases; national PA governance records
Climate_Rationale: Assessment completion from institutional records; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: 4.CY.1 Species Threat Abatement and Restoration (STAR) metric
Units_Measure: Reduction in global extinction risk attributable to specific conservation actions (RLI-equivalent units)
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 4 (complementary). Conservation actions against quantified extinction risk reduction.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: Mair et al. 2021; IUCN Red List threat data; species range maps; STAR dataset (iucn.org/star)
Climate_Rationale: STAR is computed from IUCN threat coding and species ranges; climate is one threat category but no climate data enter (Legend 1, rule B).

Indicator_Name: 4.CY.2 Number of island invasive alien species eradications
Units_Measure: Cumulative number of successful IAS eradications on islands globally
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 4 / T6 (complementary). Conservation success in preventing island extinctions.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: Island Conservation eradication database; IUCN ISSG; Global Island Invasive Vertebrate Eradication database
Climate_Rationale: Eradication programme records; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: 5.CY.1 Inland fisheries threat indicator
Units_Measure: Index of threats to freshwater fisheries (overfishing, habitat loss, IAS, pollution, climate change)
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 5 (complementary). Freshwater fisheries health often overlooked in global fisheries monitoring.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: FAO inland fisheries assessments; IUCN freshwater biodiversity assessments; national inland fisheries data
Climate_Rationale: Inland fisheries threatened by drought, altered flow regimes and warming — all climate-sensitive; climate is one explicit threat category.

Indicator_Name: 5.CY.2 Red List Index – internationally traded species
Units_Measure: RLI (0–1) for species involved in international trade (CITES-listed and others)
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 5 (complementary). Extinction risk of species in international trade.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: IUCN Red List; CITES Trade Database; TRAFFIC; UNEP-WCMC
Climate_Rationale: RLI based on IUCN classifications; overexploitation is primary driver; climate is secondary.

Indicator_Name: 5.CY.3 Red List Index – impacts of fisheries
Units_Measure: RLI (0–1) disaggregated for threat: 'biological resource use by fishing'
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 5 / T9, T10 (complementary). Extinction risk attributable to fishing pressure.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: IUCN Red List; FishBase; BirdLife International
Climate_Rationale: Aggregates IUCN Red List category changes. Climate change is a recognised threat driver, but assessments are expert status classifications: no climate data enter the calculation and weather does not move the annual value (Legend 1, rule B).

Indicator_Name: 5.CY.4 Marine Stewardship Council Certified Catch
Units_Measure: Million tonnes of MSC-certified seafood catch; % of global wild catch
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 5 / T10 (complementary). Sustainable fisheries certification as a market governance outcome.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: Marine Stewardship Council certification database (https://www.msc.org)
Climate_Rationale: MSC certification from administrative records; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: 5.CY.5 Total catch of cetaceans under the International Convention for the Regulation of Whaling
Units_Measure: Annual catch/take of whales, dolphins and porpoises under IWC-regulated hunts
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 5 (complementary). Extraction of large marine mammals under international regulation.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: International Whaling Commission (IWC) catch statistics; CITES trade data
Climate_Rationale: Catch of cetaceans reported under the ICRW, from administrative returns; no climate or weather data enter the calculation and weather does not move the value. Climate relevance of the subject is carried by Policy_Sector, not by this score (rule A).

Indicator_Name: 5.CY.6 By-catch of vulnerable and non-target species
Policy_Sector: Nature & Biodiversity | Marine & Fisheries | Trade & Industry
Units_Measure: Annual estimated tonnes and species composition of non-target by-catch from commercial fisheries
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 5 (complementary). Indirect fishing mortality on turtles, seabirds, elasmobranchs.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: FAO by-catch assessments; national fisheries observer programme data; RFMOs; OBIS
Climate_Rationale: By-catch from observer and logbook data; climate-driven distribution shifts are a background driver but no climate data enter (Legend 1, rule B).

Indicator_Name: 5.CY.7 Number of MSC Chain of Custody certification holders by distribution country
Units_Measure: Count of businesses certified to MSC Chain of Custody standard for sustainable seafood traceability
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 5 / T16 (complementary). Supply-chain governance for sustainable seafood.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: Marine Stewardship Council Chain of Custody certification database
Climate_Rationale: Certification from MSC records; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: 5.CY.8 Biodiversity-based trade growth rates
Units_Measure: Annual growth rate (%) in legal international trade in wild species (CITES-listed and biodiversity-based products)
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 5 (complementary). Whether legal biodiversity-based trade is growing within sustainable limits.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: CITES Trade Database; UNCTAD trade statistics; TRAFFIC
Climate_Rationale: Trade growth from CITES and customs data; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: 6.CY.1 Red List Index – impacts of invasive alien species
Units_Measure: RLI (0–1) disaggregated for threat: invasive alien species
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 6 / T4 (complementary). Extinction risk attributable to IAS — second leading biodiversity threat.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: IUCN Red List; GBIF; GRIIS; McGeoch et al. 2010; Butchart et al. methodology
Climate_Rationale: RLI based on Red List classifications; climate warming facilitates IAS establishment.

Indicator_Name: 7.CY.1 Trends in loss of reactive nitrogen to the environment
Units_Measure: Tg N/year emitted to atmosphere, water and land; % exceedance of critical loads
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 7 (complementary). Reactive nitrogen pollution as a key biodiversity driver.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: IIASA; EDGAR; EMEP; FAO nitrogen budget data; Sutton et al. 2011
Climate_Rationale: Rainfall directly determines wet nitrogen deposition rates; EMEP model uses precipitation as direct input.

Indicator_Name: 7.CY.2 Trends in nitrogen deposition
Units_Measure: Kg N/ha/year deposited to ecosystems from atmospheric sources; % of ecosystem area exceeding critical loads
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 7 (complementary). Atmospheric nitrogen deposition driving acidification and eutrophication.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: EMEP atmospheric chemistry-transport model; IIASA; critical loads databases (CEH, UBA)
Climate_Rationale: EMEP model uses precipitation and atmospheric data as direct inputs; wet deposition varies directly with rainfall.

Indicator_Name: 7.CY.3 Proportion of municipal solid waste collected and managed in controlled facilities
Units_Measure: % of MSW collected and managed in controlled facilities (sanitary landfill, recycling, incineration); by cities
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 7 (complementary). Solid waste management preventing biodiversity pollution. Relevant to SDG 11.6.1.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: UNSD/UNEP WASTEAWARE; WHO municipal waste data; national waste statistics
Climate_Rationale: Waste management from administrative records; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: 7.CY.4 Hazardous waste generation per capita
Units_Measure: Kg of hazardous waste generated per person per year; by waste category. Relevant to SDG 12.4.2.
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 7 (complementary). Hazardous chemicals as a source of biodiversity pollution.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: UNSD hazardous waste statistics; Basel Convention national reports; SDG 12.4.2 global database
Climate_Rationale: Hazardous waste from industrial production statistics; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: 7.CY.5 Trends in litter including microplastics in water column and on seafloor
Units_Measure: Concentration (items or g/km²) of litter and microplastics in marine environments; by medium and size class
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 7 (complementary). Plastic pollution persisting in marine ecosystems.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: OSPAR Beach Litter monitoring; UNEP GESAMP; OBIS; Copernicus Marine Service
Climate_Rationale: Litter and microplastic concentrations from monitoring surveys; storms and currents move deposition but no weather data enter (Legend 1, rule G; aligned with [IND-E-015], [IND-B-199]).

Indicator_Name: 7.CY.6 Pesticide use per area of cropland
Policy_Sector: Land Use & Agriculture | Biosecurity | Pollution & Waste
Units_Measure: Kg active ingredient of pesticides applied per hectare of cropland per year
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 7 (complementary). Pesticide application intensity as a direct pollution driver.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: FAO FAOSTAT pesticide application statistics; national agricultural censuses
Climate_Rationale: Pesticide use from agricultural statistics; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: 8.CY.1 Above-ground biomass stock in forest (tonnes/ha)
Units_Measure: Mean above-ground carbon biomass density (tC/ha) in forests; trend over time
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 8 (complementary). Forest carbon stocks as indicator of climate regulation capacity.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: ESA GlobBiomass; GEDI LiDAR; national forest inventory biomass; FAO FRA
Climate_Rationale: Forest biomass affected by climate-driven fire, drought and temperature-driven productivity changes.

Indicator_Name: 8.CY.2 National greenhouse gas inventories from land use, land-use change and forestry (LULUCF)
Units_Measure: Tg CO₂e/year net GHG flux from LULUCF sector in national inventories
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 8 (complementary). LULUCF flux as the climate-biodiversity interface indicator.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: UNFCCC national GHG inventories (LULUCF sector); FAO FAOSTAT LULUCF emissions data
Climate_Rationale: LULUCF inventories estimate carbon fluxes with models that take temperature and rainfall indirectly (growth, decomposition); climate data enter within underlying models (Legend 2, rules C and G; aligned with [IND-B-166], [IND-J-044]).

Indicator_Name: 8.CY.3 Proportion of local governments with local DRR strategies in line with national strategies
Units_Measure: % of local governments with DRR strategies aligned to national strategies; SDG 11.b.2
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 8 (complementary). Sub-national climate resilience governance. Official SDG 11.b.2.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: UNDRR Sendai Framework monitoring; national local government databases; ICLEI
Climate_Rationale: Proportion of local governments with DRR strategies, from policy records. no climate or weather data enter the calculation and weather does not move the value. Climate relevance of the subject is carried by Policy_Sector, not by this score (rule A).

Indicator_Name: 8.CY.4 Average marine acidity (pH) at agreed representative sampling stations
Units_Measure: Mean surface ocean pH at designated GOA-ON monitoring stations; trend in ocean acidification; SDG 14.3.1
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 8 (complementary). Ocean acidification as a direct climate impact on marine biodiversity. Official SDG 14.3.1.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: Global Ocean Acidification Observing Network (GOA-ON); ARGO floats; Bakker et al. SOCAT; NOAA PMEL
Climate_Rationale: Ocean pH directly tracks CO₂-driven acidification; pH values are among the most direct climate change impacts on marine biodiversity.

Indicator_Name: 9.CY.1 Spawning stock biomass of commercially exploited species
Policy_Sector: Nature & Biodiversity | Marine & Fisheries | Trade & Industry
Units_Measure: Tonnes of spawning stock biomass for commercially exploited fish and shellfish populations; vs. reference point
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 9 (complementary). Population health of commercially exploited wild species.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: ICES; CCAMLR; WCPFC; FAO Fisheries Division; national stock assessments
Climate_Rationale: Spawning stock biomass affected by ocean warming through recruitment, productivity and species distribution.

Indicator_Name: 9.CY.2 Volume of production per labour unit by farming/pastoral/forestry enterprise size
Units_Measure: Agricultural/forestry productivity per worker, by enterprise size class; SDG 2.3.1
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 9 / T10 (complementary). Productivity outcomes for small-scale food producers. Relevant to SDG 2.3.1.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: FAO RIGA; World Bank LSMS surveys; national agricultural censuses; ILO
Climate_Rationale: Agricultural productivity partly climate-sensitive through yields; measured from surveys.

Indicator_Name: 9.CY.3 Red List Index – impact of utilization
Units_Measure: RLI (0–1) tracking extinction risk driven by direct utilisation/exploitation of all wild species
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 9 (complementary). Overexploitation-driven extinction risk across wild species use contexts.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: IUCN Red List; Butchart et al. 2008; TRAFFIC; FAO utilisation classifications
Climate_Rationale: RLI reflects utilisation threat; climate is a secondary background factor.

Indicator_Name: 10.CY.1 Agrobiodiversity Index
Units_Measure: Index of diversity of crops, varieties, livestock breeds and wild relatives maintained in agricultural systems
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 10 (complementary). On-farm crop diversity as a biodiversity and food security indicator.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: Khoury et al.; FAO State of the World's Biodiversity for Food and Agriculture; national genebank records
Climate_Rationale: Crop diversity from field surveys and genebank records; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: 10.CY.2 Soil organic carbon stocks
Units_Measure: GtC or tC/ha of organic carbon in agricultural soils; trend over time
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 10 (complementary). Soil carbon as biodiversity indicator and climate mitigation outcome.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: ISRIC SoilGrids (https://soilgrids.org); FAO GSOC; national soil monitoring networks
Climate_Rationale: Soil carbon decomposition is temperature-dependent; precipitation affects carbon inputs through plant productivity.

Indicator_Name: 10.CY.3 Red List Index – forest specialist species
Units_Measure: RLI (0–1) for forest-dependent bird, mammal and amphibian species
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 10 (complementary). Extinction risk of biodiversity dependent on managed forest ecosystems.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: IUCN Red List; BirdLife International; Butchart et al. methodology
Climate_Rationale: Aggregates IUCN Red List category changes. Climate change is a recognised threat driver, but assessments are expert status classifications: no climate data enter the calculation and weather does not move the annual value (Legend 1, rule B).

Indicator_Name: 10.CY.4 Area of forest under sustainable management – FSC and PEFC certification
Units_Measure: Million ha and % of total forest under FSC or PEFC certified sustainable forest management
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 10 (complementary). Sustainable forest management certification as a governance outcome.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: Forest Stewardship Council (FSC) certification database; PEFC International; FAO FRA
Climate_Rationale: Certification area from FSC/PEFC administrative records; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: 11.CY.1 Air emission accounts
Units_Measure: Tonnes/year of air pollutant emissions by sector; national SEEA-aligned air emission accounts
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 11 (complementary). Air pollution as driver of ecosystem service degradation.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: EDGAR; EMEP; national atmospheric emission inventories; Eurostat SEEA air emission accounts
Climate_Rationale: SEEA air emission accounts compiled from inventory activity data and emission factors; weather enters only marginally via heating demand (Legend 1, rule C).

Indicator_Name: 11.CY.2 Proportion of local authorities with participatory water and sanitation management policies
Units_Measure: % of local administrative units with operational policies for community participation in water/sanitation; SDG 6.b.1
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 11 (complementary). Local governance of freshwater provision as ecosystem service. Official SDG 6.b.1.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: WHO/UNICEF JMP; national local government databases; UNSD SDG 6.b.1 monitoring
Climate_Rationale: Governance indicator from administrative records; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: 11.CY.3 Proportion of population using safely managed drinking water services
Units_Measure: % of population using safely managed drinking water (SDG 6.1.1 Tier 1)
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 11 (complementary). Freshwater provisioning as key ecosystem service to people. Official SDG 6.1.1.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: WHO/UNICEF JMP; national household surveys; SDG global database
Climate_Rationale: Drinking water access from infrastructure/survey data; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: 11.CY.4 Mortality rate attributed to unsafe WASH (water, sanitation and hygiene) services
Units_Measure: Deaths per 100,000 per year from diseases from inadequate water, sanitation and hygiene; SDG 3.9.2
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 11 (complementary). Health outcome reflecting freshwater ecosystem service quality. Relevant to SDG 3.9.2.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: WHO Global Health Observatory; GBD study; national vital registration
Climate_Rationale: WASH mortality affected by climate-driven waterborne disease outbreaks; primarily a health services metric.

Indicator_Name: 11.CY.5 Number of deaths, missing persons and affected persons from disasters per 100,000 population
Units_Measure: Disaster mortality and affected persons rate per 100,000 people per year; SDG 11.5.1
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 11 (complementary). Disaster risk reduction services from ecosystems. Official SDG 11.5.1.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: CRED EM-DAT; UNDRR disaster loss database; national disaster management authorities
Climate_Rationale: Disaster mortality directly linked to extreme weather; ecosystem services modulate risk from coastal/inland flooding.

Indicator_Name: 16.CY.1 Extent to which ESD and global citizenship education are mainstreamed in national curricula
Units_Measure: Index of ESD and GCED mainstreaming in national education policies, curricula, teacher education and student assessment; SDG 4.7.1
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 16 (complementary). Education for sustainable development as enabler of sustainable consumption. Official SDG 4.7.1.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: UNESCO ESD database; national curriculum reviews; SDG 4 monitoring framework
Climate_Rationale: Education policy from administrative records; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: 16.CY.2 National recycling rate
Units_Measure: % of waste recycled nationally; total tonnes of materials recovered per year
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 16 (complementary). Circular economy indicator reducing resource pressure on biodiversity.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: Eurostat waste statistics; OECD waste recycling data; national municipal waste surveys
Climate_Rationale: Recycling rates from waste statistics; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: 16.CY.3 Human Appropriation of Net Primary Production (HANPP)
Units_Measure: % of terrestrial NPP appropriated by humans through harvest, conversion and fire; expressed as GtC/year
Policy_Goal: GBF Goal B / T16 (complementary). Aggregate human consumption pressure on the biosphere.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: IIASA; Haberl et al. 2007; FAO production data; HYDE land-use dataset; global vegetation models
Climate_Rationale: NPP modelled using temperature and rainfall as primary inputs; climate variability affects annual HANPP values.

Indicator_Name: 16.CY.4 CO2 emissions per unit of value added
Units_Measure: Tonnes CO₂ per USD of GDP by sector (carbon intensity); SDG 9.4.1
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 16 (complementary). Economic decarbonisation as a driver of biodiversity pressure reduction. Official SDG 9.4.1.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: IEA CO₂ emissions; EDGAR; World Bank national accounts; UNSD
Climate_Rationale: CO2 per unit of value added from emissions inventories and national accounts. Being a climate-policy measure is topical relevance, not data dependency (Legend 1, rules C and G; same indicator and score as [SDG-071]).

Indicator_Name: 16.CY.5 Change in water-use efficiency over time
Units_Measure: Ratio of GDP to freshwater withdrawn (USD/m³); trend over time; SDG 6.4.1
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 16 (complementary). Water use efficiency as sustainable consumption indicator. Official SDG 6.4.1.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: FAO AQUASTAT; national hydrological surveys; UNSD SDG 6.4.1 database
Climate_Rationale: Water availability directly affected by precipitation changes; efficiency ratios reflect both economic and hydrological change.

Indicator_Name: 16.CY.6 Indicators from the Life Cycle Impact Assessment (LCIA) Programme
Units_Measure: Life cycle environmental impact scores for consumer products across multiple environmental impact categories
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 16 (complementary). Product-level environmental footprint through supply chains.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: UNEP-SETAC Life Cycle Initiative; Ecoinvent; national LCA databases
Climate_Rationale: LCA includes climate change as one impact category among others; biodiversity footprint categories partially climate-linked.

Indicator_Name: 16.CY.7 Poverty level
Units_Measure: % of population below international poverty line (USD 2.15/day at 2017 PPP); SDG 1.1.1
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 16 (complementary). Poverty as a context indicator for equitable sustainable consumption. Official SDG 1.1.1.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: World Bank PovcalNet; national household surveys; ILO poverty statistics
Climate_Rationale: Poverty data from household surveys; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: 17.CY.1 Indicators related to the Cartagena Protocol on Biosafety
Units_Measure: Composite of Cartagena Protocol implementation progress indicators (LMO risk assessments, BCH submissions, biosafety legislation)
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 17 (complementary). Tracks national implementation of the Cartagena Protocol.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: CBD Biosafety Clearing-House (BCH; https://bch.cbd.int); Cartagena Protocol national reports
Climate_Rationale: Biosafety governance from administrative records; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: 20.CY.1 Researchers (full-time equivalent) per million inhabitants
Units_Measure: FTE researchers per million population; SDG 9.5.2
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 20 (complementary). Scientific research capacity as means of implementation for biodiversity. Official SDG 9.5.2.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: UNESCO Institute for Statistics; national R&D surveys; OECD MSTI
Climate_Rationale: Research capacity from educational/institutional records; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: 20.CY.2 Global imports of ICT goods by bilateral trade flows and category
Units_Measure: USD million/year in bilateral ICT goods trade; technology access proxy
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 20 (complementary). Technology access as means of implementation indicator. Relevant to SDG 17.8.1.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: UNCTAD STAT bilateral trade database; WTO International Trade Statistics
Climate_Rationale: ICT trade from customs/trade statistics; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: 21.CY.1 Growth in number of records and species in the Living Planet Index database
Units_Measure: Annual increase in species and population time-series records in ZSL Living Planet Index database
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 21 (complementary). Data richness growth in LPI monitoring programme.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: Zoological Society of London (ZSL) Living Planet Index database
Climate_Rationale: Database coverage statistics from ZSL; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: 21.CY.2 Growth in species occurrence records accessible through GBIF
Units_Measure: Cumulative species occurrence records in GBIF; annual additions
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 21 (complementary). Biodiversity data infrastructure growth.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: GBIF species occurrence database (https://www.gbif.org); digitised natural history collections
Climate_Rationale: Record counts from GBIF portal statistics; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: 21.CY.3 Growth in marine species occurrence records accessible through OBIS
Units_Measure: Cumulative marine species occurrence records in OBIS; annual additions
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 21 (complementary). Marine biodiversity data infrastructure growth.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: Ocean Biodiversity Information System (OBIS; https://obis.org); IOC-UNESCO
Climate_Rationale: Marine record counts from OBIS database statistics; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: 21.CY.4 Proportion of known species assessed through the IUCN Red List
Units_Measure: % of estimated known species with an IUCN Red List assessment; by major taxonomic group
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 21 (complementary). Coverage of the primary global species status monitoring tool.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: IUCN Red List of Threatened Species (https://www.iucnredlist.org); Butchart et al. 2010
Climate_Rationale: Assessment coverage from IUCN statistics; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: 21.CY.5 Number of assessments on the IUCN Red List of Threatened Species
Units_Measure: Cumulative count of species assessments published on IUCN Red List; annual additions by taxon group
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 21 (complementary). Total IUCN Red List assessment coverage as a data completeness indicator.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: IUCN Red List statistics (https://www.iucnredlist.org/statistics)
Climate_Rationale: Assessment counts from IUCN records; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: 21.CY.6 World Association of Zoos and Aquariums bioliteracy survey (biodiversity literacy in zoo and aquarium visitors)
Units_Measure: % increase in biodiversity literacy score among zoo/aquarium visitors before and after visit
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 21 (complementary). Biodiversity awareness through formal non-formal education at zoos/aquaria.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: WAZA (World Association of Zoos and Aquariums); Chester Zoo bioliteracy survey programme
Climate_Rationale: Zoo visitor surveys; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: 22.CY.1 Proportions of positions in national and local institutions held by IPLCs, women, youth and persons with disabilities
Units_Measure: % of seats in (a) legislatures; (b) public service; (c) judiciary held by equity groups; disaggregated by type
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 22 / T23 (complementary). Inclusive governance representation as proxy for equitable decision-making.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: Inter-Parliamentary Union; UN Women; national civil service records; UNDP governance data
Climate_Rationale: Representation data from institutional records; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: 22.CY.2 Proportion of countries with systems to track allocations for gender equality and women's empowerment
Units_Measure: % of countries with gender-responsive budget tracking systems; SDG 5.c.1
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 22 (complementary). Gender-responsive fiscal governance for biodiversity finance. Official SDG 5.c.1.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: UNDP; UN Women; national finance ministry data; SDG 5.c.1 monitoring
Climate_Rationale: Gender budgeting from national finance records; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: 22.CY.3 Proportion of agricultural population with secure land rights over agricultural land, by sex
Policy_Sector: Land Use & Agriculture | Governance, Society & Data
Units_Measure: % with ownership or secure rights over agricultural land, disaggregated by sex; SDG 5.a.1
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 22 / T23 (complementary). Women's land rights as a foundation for biodiversity stewardship. Official SDG 5.a.1.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: FAO Gender and Land Rights database; national land tenure surveys; World Bank LSMS
Climate_Rationale: Land rights from survey and cadastral data; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: 22.CY.4 Proportion of countries where legal framework guarantees women's equal rights to land ownership and control
Units_Measure: % of countries with legal guarantees of women's equal land rights (including customary law); SDG 5.a.2
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 22 / T23 (complementary). Legal gender equality for land as prerequisite for governance. Official SDG 5.a.2.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: FAO Gender and Land Rights database; UN Women legal assessments; OECD gender indicators
Climate_Rationale: Legal framework data from legislation reviews; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: 22.CY.5 Proportion of population who believe decision-making is inclusive and responsive, by sex/age/disability/IPLC
Units_Measure: % of population satisfied with inclusivity of governance processes, by equity group; SDG 16.7.2
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 22 / T23 (complementary). Perceived governance quality and inclusion. Official SDG 16.7.2.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: Gallup World Poll; national governance surveys; UNDP perception surveys
Climate_Rationale: Governance perception from surveys; no climate data.

Indicator_Name: 22.CY.6 Area covered by territories governed and managed by custodian IPLCs (ICCAs – territories of life)
Units_Measure: Total area (km²) of land under IPLC governance and management (territories of life / ICCAs); trend
Policy_Goal: GBF Target 22 (complementary). IPLC-managed territories as biodiversity conservation outcome and rights recognition.
Source_Reference: CBD/COP/16/L.26/Rev.1 (26 February 2025). Monitoring framework for the KM-GBF – Annex II (component/complementary indicators). COP-16 resumed session, Rome. https://www.cbd.int/doc/c/1e13/f20d/81cd8447744640bbd21e008f/cop-16-l-26-rev1-en.pdf
Data_Source: ICCA Consortium territories of life database; UNEP-WCMC; LandMark platform; national IPLC territory cadastres
Climate_Rationale: IPLC territory extent from governance records; climate change threatens territory integrity but area is not climate-derived.
